summary: EDA API KPIs are high /api/eda latency, high CPU and gateway 503s; activations keep persistent WebSocket connections to the Daphne server in the eda-api pod, which many activations or heavy output can overwhelm. On OpenShift scale the eda-api deployment in proportion to activations; on VM and container installs add hybrid nodes.
questions: How do I scale the EDA WebSocket service?
Why do EDA activations fail with many activations running?
Where does Daphne run in EDA on OpenShift?
How many eda-api replicas do I need?
